steps.title: See the route: build fixtures.db with tests/fixtures.py, then serve it with `datasette fixtures.db` (docs/contributing.rst)
Serve the database and open it in your browser
Serve on another port, with a smaller page size, immutable

trapsToWarn: tests/fixtures.py imports pytest, but the install doesn't pull it in: run `pip install pytest` before building fixtures.db.
The README's `uv run` prefix doesn't apply without uv: run `python tests/fixtures.py fixtures.db` and `datasette fixtures.db` directly after `pip install -e .`.
--port must be an integer: `--port=abc` is rejected.
--host cannot contain =: `--host=A=B` starts, then fails with a name-resolution error.
Option names must be exact: `--pot=8011` fails with 'No such option'; `--extr-db-filename` likewise fails for fixtures.py.
fixtures.py refuses to overwrite an existing fixtures.db: pass --recreate to reset it.
